To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) a sufficient condition for the differentiability of the optimum with respect to the parameters is provided; (2) a formula for computing the derivative of the optimum with re-spect to the parameter is given; and (3) the formula is given in the form that is suitable for computation.

(i) the optimal solution of an optimal control problem is differentiable with respect, to a parameter if and only if it is differentiable with the respect to the parameter in each of the optimal trajectories and (ii) the derivative of the optimal solution with respect to the parameters can be computed by solving initial-value problems of the linear differential equations.
the comparative dynamics of an optimal control problem can be obtained from the solutions to the linearized problem.
